scope: Every populated canonical board reference during ordinary continuous recording with USB detached and the indicator commanded off

groups.name: explicit_active_semiconductors
groups.accounting: U11 and its traffic are in the storage allocation; U1/U4/U10 plus unresolved dynamic and leakage loads are in the remaining non-storage allocation; U3/U8/U12 published rows are explicit.

groups.name: usb_only_path
groups.recording_state: USB detached; VBUS and VBUS_CHARGER unpowered
groups.accounting: No intentional battery-fed DC path. Leakage/backfeed is covered by the remaining non-storage/misc allocation and must be checked on hardware.

groups.name: explicit_guard_dividers
groups.accounting: Included by divider_short_case in explicit_guard_and_BOR_total; this intentionally over-bounds the ordinary NTC/reference branches.

groups.name: battery_measurement_divider
groups.recording_state: R33/R34 continuously across BAT; C28 has no ideal DC load
groups.accounting: Divider current and capacitor leakage are covered by the remaining non-storage/misc allocation; battery-side whole-device measurement is authoritative.

groups.name: control_bias_and_signal_resistors
groups.recording_state: mixed static bias, series signal, or charger-programming networks
groups.accounting: Any recording-state DC or switching loss is inside the remaining non-storage/misc allocation; charger-input-only branches have no source with USB detached.

groups.name: discrete_semiconductors
groups.recording_state: D6 commanded off; Q3 VBUS detector off; Q4 state controlled but charger input absent
groups.accounting: Leakage and any GPIO/control loss are inside the remaining non-storage/misc allocation; the indicator allocation is explicitly zero only for commanded ordinary recording duty.

groups.name: capacitors
groups.recording_state: rail decoupling, filtering, or transient storage
groups.accounting: No ideal steady-state DC load; dielectric leakage and charge/discharge losses are inside the remaining non-storage/misc or storage allocation according to rail.

groups.name: passive_interfaces
groups.recording_state: battery connector closed; button normally open
groups.accounting: No independent load; contact loss is included only by battery-side whole-device measurement.

budget_boundary.warning: Coverage is bookkeeping, not evidence that the allocation is sufficient. It must not be used to claim 16 h runtime.
budget_boundary.authoritative_acceptance: Measure battery-side charge over a complete 16 h encrypted recording on qualified hardware and verify continuous recording plus rail diagnostics.
